description: Edge detection on pin 3 with pull-up (the same example on the Mega 2560).
basis: the output of the example on the Uno (class derived: derived by hand from the sketch source (C++ semantics, avr-gcc: int is 16 bit) and the 'Beobachtung' comment of the example; pressing = LOW at 100 ms, releasing = HIGH at 300 ms) holds for the Mega 2560: the sketch uses no feature in which the ATmega328P and the ATmega2560 differ (no pin above 13, A0 as ADC channel 0, 16 MHz, 16-bit int, same core 1.8.8); no recording on a Mega exists
